source: Red tide به علت غلظت بالاتر از حد نورمال Karenia brevis که یک ارگانیزم بحری یک حجروی طبیعی است، بوجود می آید.
english_gold: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
english_hypothesis: Red tide occurs due to the concentration of Karenia brevis, a natural marine organism, which is higher than normal.

source: فکتور های طبیعی میتواند باهم تقاطع کنند تا شرایط دلخواه را ایجاد کند و به این ترتیب تعداد این الجی بصورت چشمگیری افزایش یابد.
english_gold: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
english_hypothesis: Natural factors can intersect to create favorable conditions and thus the number of these algae can increase significantly.

source: این الجی نیوروتوکسین را تولید میکند که اعصاب را در هر دو انسان ها و ماهی ها غیرفعال کرده میتواند.
english_gold: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
english_hypothesis: This bacterium produces a neurotoxin that can inactivate nerves in both humans and fish.

source: ماهی ها معمولاً به علت غلظت های بالای توکسین در آب ها میمیرند.
english_gold: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
english_hypothesis: Fish usually die due to high concentrations of toxins in the water.

source: انسان ها با تنفس آب آلوده که توسط باد و امواج به هوا انتقال یافته است، متاثر گردیده میتواند.
english_gold: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
english_hypothesis: People can be affected by breathing in contaminated water that has been carried into the air by wind and waves.

source: برای بازگشت به سطح انرژی قبلی خود، آنها باید انرژی اضافی دریافت شده از آن را از بین ببرند.
english_gold: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
english_hypothesis: To return to their previous energy level, they must eliminate the extra energy they received.

source: آنها این کار را با انتشار نور و ذرات کوچک به نام "فوتون" انجام می دهند.
english_gold: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
english_hypothesis: They do this by emitting light and small particles called "photons."

source: دانشمندان این فرآیند را "انتشار محرک تابش" می نامند زیرا اتوم ها با نور شدید تحریک می شوند ، نور فوتون ها را منتشر می کند و نور نوعی تابش است.
english_gold: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
english_hypothesis: Scientists call this process "excitation emission" because atoms are excited by intense light, emit photons, and light is a type of radiation.

source: تصویر بعدی انتشار فوتون های اتومی را نشان می دهد. البته عکسها در واقع بسیار کوچکتر از عکس هستند.
english_gold: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
english_hypothesis: The next image shows the emission of atomic photons. Of course, the images are actually much smaller than the picture.

source: فوتون ها حتی کوچکتر از چیزهایی هستند که اتوم می سازند!
english_gold: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
english_hypothesis: Photons are even smaller than the things that atoms make!

source: عناصر و ترکیبات می توانند از یک حالت به حالت دیگر تبدیل شده و تغییر نکنند.
english_gold: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
english_hypothesis: Elements and compounds can be transformed from one state to another and remain unchanged.

source: گاز نایتروجن هنوز همان خواص نایتروجن مایع را دارد. حالت مایع آن متراکم تر است اما مالیکول های آن هنوز یکسان هستند.
english_gold: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
english_hypothesis: Nitrogen gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. Its liquid state is more dense but its molecules are still the same.

source: آب نمونه ای دیگر است، آب ترکیب دو اتم هیدروجن و یک اتم اکسیجن می باشد.
english_gold: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
english_hypothesis: Another sample of water is a combination of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

source: دارای ساختمان مالیکولی یکسان می باشد چه گاز، چه مایع و چه جامد باشد.
english_gold: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
english_hypothesis: Has a uniform molecular structure whether gas, liquid or solid.

source: اگرچه حالت فیزیکی آن ممکن تغییر بکند، اما حالت کیمیایی آن ثابت می ماند.
english_gold: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
english_hypothesis: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains constant.

source: این را pH کیمیاوی می نامند. می توانید با استفاده از آب کباب سرخ یک شاخص را تهیه کنید.
english_gold: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
english_hypothesis: This is called chemical pH. You can make a indicator using red cabbage water.

source: رنگ آب کباب بسته به میزان اسیدی یا اساسی بودن (قلیایی) این ماده کیمیاوی تغییر می کند.
english_gold: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
english_hypothesis: The color of the meat changes depending on the acidity or alkalinity of this chemical substance.

source: سطح pH با مقدار یونهای هایدروجن (H) در ماده کیمیاوی مورد آزمایش مشخص می شود.
english_gold: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
english_hypothesis: The pH level is determined by the amount of hydrogen ions (H) in the chemical substance being tested.

source: یونهای هایدروجن پروتونهایی هستند که الکترونهای آنها از آنها جدا شده است (زیرا اتومهای هایدروجن دارای یک پروتون و یک الکترون هستند).
english_gold: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
english_hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are protons that have lost their electrons (since hydrogen atoms have one proton and one electron).

source: این فقط این را تایید نمی کند که حد اقل بعضی از داینسور ها پر داشتند که یک نظریه از قبل رایج شده است، مگر توضیحات را فراهم می سازد که فوسیل ها نمی توانند، مانند رنگ و ترتیب سه بعدی.
english_gold: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
english_hypothesis: This does not only confirm that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory that was previously widespread, but also provides explanations that fossils cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.

source: دانشمندان می گویند که پر های این حیوان در قسمت بالا دارای رنگ نصواری است و در قسمت پائین دارای رنگ کمرنگ زرد یا نارنجی است.
english_gold: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
english_hypothesis: Scientists say that the feathers of this animal have a dark color on top and a light yellow or orange color on the bottom.

source: این یافته همچنان به تکامل پر ها در پرندگان نیز کمک میکند.
english_gold: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
english_hypothesis: This finding also helps in the evolution of feathers in birds.

source: اینکه پر ها داینسور دارای یک محور توسعه یافته که بنام رچیز یاد می شوند نیست، بلکه دارای خواص پر ها نیز نیست – خار و موی کوچک – محققان دریافتند که رچیز احتمالا یک انکشاف انقلابی بعدی بود که این یک ویژگی دیگری است.
english_gold: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
english_hypothesis: It is not that the feathers have a developed axis called rachis, but also not having the properties of feathers - barbs and small hairs - researchers found that rachis was probably a revolutionary development, which is another feature.

source: ساختار پر نشان میدهد که آنها در پرواز استفاده نمی شدند مگر بمنظور تنظیم درجه حرارت یا نمایش. محققان پیشنهاد کردنند که اگرچه این دم یک داینسور جوان است، مگر این نمونه پر های جوان را نشان میدهد نه پر های چوچه را.
english_gold: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
english_hypothesis: The structure indicates that they were not used in flight except for temperature regulation or display. Researchers suggest that although this tail is from a young dinosaur, this specimen shows young feathers, not down feathers.

source: تاثیر که تیم در تلاش آن بود ممکن به علت قوه موجی میان ماده تاریک کهکشان و ماده تاریک راه شیر باشد.
english_gold: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
english_hypothesis: The effect that the team was trying to achieve may be due to the wave force between the dark matter of the galaxy and the dark matter of the Milky Way.

source: طوریکه مهتاب بالای زمین ضربه وارد میکند، باعث تشکیل امواج می گردد، به همین طور راه شیری بالای کهکشان قوی قوه وارد میکند.
english_gold: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
english_hypothesis: As the moon strikes the earth, it causes waves, similarly the Milky Way exerts a strong force.

source: دانشمندان توانستند نتیجه گیری نمایند که یک ماده تاریک ماده تاریک دیگری مانند ماده منظم تحت تاثیر قرار دهد.
english_gold: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
english_hypothesis: Scientists were able to conclude that a dark matter can affect another dark matter like regular matter.

source: این تیوری میگوید که بیشترین ماده تاریک اطراف کهکشان در اطراف کهکشان نوع حلقه نور موقعیت دارد و از اجزای کوچک زیاد ساخته شده است.
english_gold: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
english_hypothesis: This theory says that the majority of the dark matter around the galaxy is located around the galaxy in a ring shape and is made up of many small components.

source: هم سیانوریک اسید و میلامین در نمونه های ادرار حیوانات که بعد از مصرف غذای ملوس شده شان مردند پیدا شد.
english_gold: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
english_hypothesis: Cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples of animals that died after consuming the contaminated food.

source: محققین در پوهنتون میگوید، این دو مرکب با هم تعامل میکنند تا کریستال های تشکیل دهد که شاید فعالیت گرده را متوقف نماید.
english_gold: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
english_hypothesis: Researchers at the university say that these two compounds interact to form crystals that may stop pollen activity.

source: محققین کریستال های را مشاهده کرد که در ادرار پشک با علاوه کردن میلامین و سیانوریک اسید بوجود آمده بودند.
english_gold: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
english_hypothesis: Researchers observed crystals that had formed in the urine of a patient after administering melamine and cyanuric acid.

source: ترکیب این کریستال ها با آنهای که در ادرار حیوانات متأثر شده پیدا شد یکسان بود زمانیکه توسط طیف نما فرو بنفش (FTIR) مقایسه شد.
english_gold: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
english_hypothesis: The combination of these crystals was the same as those found in the urine of affected animals when compared by Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

source: زمانیکه یک گروه کوچک موجودات زنده (یک جمیعت کوچک) از جماعت اصلی که آنها مربوط اش میشود جدا میشود (مثلاً اگر آنها بطرف یک سلسله کوه یا دریا حرکت کنند، یا اگر آنها بطرف یک جزیره جدید حرکت کنند تا بتوانند دوباره به راحتی برگردند) آنها محیط متفاوت را در مقایسه با محیط قبلی شاهد خواهند بود.
english_gold: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
english_hypothesis: When a small group of living beings (a small population) separates from the main population to which they belong (for example, if they move towards a mountain range or sea, or if they move towards a new island so they can easily return), they will experience a different environment compared to their previous environment.

source: محیط جدید منابع متفاوت و رقیبان متفاوت دارد، از اینرو جمیعت جدید به ویژگی های متفاوت یا سازگاری ها جهت اینکه یک رقیب قوی در مقایسه با چیزی که بودند باشند نیاز دارند.
english_gold: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
english_hypothesis: My environment has different resources and different competitors, therefore the new community needs different features or adaptations in order to be a strong competitor compared to what they were.

source: بالاخره، بعد از هزارها یا حتی میلیون ها سال، دو جمیعت چنان با هم متفاوت خواهند بود که دیگر یک نوع خوانده نخواهند شد.
english_gold: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
english_hypothesis: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two groups will be so different that they will no longer be considered the same species.

source: ما این پروسه را شکل گیری مینامیم، که معنی اش فقط تشکیل یک نوع جدید است. شکل گیری یک نتیجه غیرقابل جلوگیری و یک بخش مهم تکامل است.
english_gold: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
english_hypothesis: We call this process formation, which means only the formation of a new type. Formation is an inevitable result and an important part of evolution.

source: موزازورهای شکارچیهای اوج زمان خود بودند، بجز موزازورهای دیگر، از هیچ چیزی نمی ترسیدند.
english_gold: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
english_hypothesis: Hunters of the time were fearless, except for other hunters, they feared nothing.

source: الاشه ی طویل اش با بیش از 70 دندان تیغ-مانند، همراه یک ست اضافی در سقف دهانش پرکاری شده بود. به این معنی که هیچ چیزی نمیتواند از مسیر آن راه فرار نماید.
english_gold: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
english_hypothesis: The long snout with more than 70 blade-like teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, was busy. This meant nothing could escape its path.

source: دقیقاً نمیفهمیم، اما احتمالاً دارای زبان خاردار بوده، رژیم غذایی آن شامل سنگ پشت ها، ماهیان بزرگ، دیگر انواع موزازورها و حتی ممکن است ادمخوارد بوده باشد.
english_gold: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
english_hypothesis: We are not exactly sure, but it probably had a spiky skin, its diet included rock plates, large fish, other types of mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.

source: این همچنان به هر چیزی که داخل آب میشد حمله میکرد؛ حتی یک دایناسور عظیم الجسه مانند T.rex نظیر اش نخواهد بود.
english_gold: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
english_hypothesis: It still attacked anything that went into the water; not even a huge dinosaur like T.rex would be its match.

source: حشرات اولین حیواناتی بودند که به هوا پرواز کردند. توانایی پرواز به آنها کمک کرد تا به راحتی از دست دشمنان فرار کنند و غذا و جفت خود را با موثریت بیشتری بیابند.
english_gold: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
english_hypothesis: Insects were the first animals to fly. The ability to fly helped them to easily escape from enemies and find food and mates more effectively.

source: اکثر حشرات دارای مزیت خم کردن بالهایشان در امتداد بدن به عقب می باشند.
english_gold: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
english_hypothesis: Most insects have the advantage of folding their wings along the body backward.

source: این به آنها طیف گسترده تری از مکان های کوچکتر برای پنهان شدن از شکارچیان را میدهد.
english_gold: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
english_hypothesis: This gives them a wider range of smaller places to hide from hunters.

source: امروزه، تنها حشراتي كه نمي توانند بالهای خود را به عقب خم كنند، سنجاقک ها و آسیابک ها می باشند.
english_gold: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
english_hypothesis: Today, the only insects that cannot fold their wings back are the beetles and weevils.

source: جهان دارای بیش از 5000 زبان مختلف، شامل بیش از بیست زبان با 50 میلیون متکلم یا بیشتر است.
english_gold: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
english_hypothesis: The world has more than 5000 different languages, including more than twenty languages with 50 million speakers or more.

source: برآورد های متفاوت برای شمار افرادی که به زبان هندی صحبت وجود دارد. تخمین شده است که بین دومین و چهارمین زبان رایج در دنیا باشد.
english_gold: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
english_hypothesis: Different estimates for the number of people who speak the Hindi language. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most widely spoken languages in the world.

source: تعداد گویندگان اصلی نظر به شمارش یا عدم شمارش لهجه های نزدیک، متفاوت است.
english_gold: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
english_hypothesis: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not the closely related dialects are counted.

source: اندازه برآوردها از 340 میلیون تا 500 میلیون گوینده در حال تغییر است، و تا حدود 800 میلیون نفر می توانند این زبان را بفهمند.
english_gold: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
english_hypothesis: The estimates of the number of speakers range from 340 million to 500 million, and up to around 800 million people can understand this language.

source: هندی و اردو در کلمات مشابه هم استند اما از نگاه خط متفاوت هستند؛ در مکالمات روزمره، گویندگان هردو زبان به سادگی میتوانند یکدیگر را درک کنند.
english_gold: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
english_hypothesis: Hindi and Urdu are similar in words but different in script; in daily conversations, speakers of both languages can easily understand each other.

source: بینظمی کمبود توجه "یک سندرم عصبی است که سه علامت کلاسیک آن شامل هوس خواهی حواس پرتی و بیش فعالی یا انرژی اضافی است."
english_gold: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
english_hypothesis: "ADHD is a neurological disorder that includes three classic symptoms: inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity."

source: این یک معیوبیت یادگیری نیست، این یک بیظمی یادگیری است. این "3 تا 5 درصد از همه کودکان، شاید به اندازه 2 میلیون کودک آمریکایی" را شامل می سازد.
english_gold: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
english_hypothesis: This is not a learning disability, this is a learning difference. It affects "3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children."

source: این کودکان معمولاٌ درگیر مشکلات زیادی می شوند، زیرا برای تحریک مغز خود <درگیر رفتارهای پرخطر، دعوا، و به چالش کشیدن قدرت> می شوند، زیرا مغز آنها با روش های عادی تحریک نمی شود.
english_gold: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
english_hypothesis: These children usually get involved in many problems, because they are involved in risky behaviors, fighting, and challenging authority, because their brains are not stimulated in normal ways.

english_gold: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
english_hypothesis: The majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is concentrated on reclaimed land along the northern coast.

source: جلوه ساختمان هایی که خط افق هنگ کنگ را می سازد به بار چارتی درخشان تشبیه شده می شود که با حضور آبهای بندر ویکتوریا ظاهر می گردد.
english_gold: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
english_hypothesis: The skyline of buildings that form the Hong Kong horizon is likened to a bright chart, which appears with the presence of Victoria Harbor.

source: برای دیدن بهترین مناظر هانگ کانگ، جزیره را ترک کرده به سمت ساحل کولون در سمت مخالف بروید.
english_gold: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
english_hypothesis: To see the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head toward the coast of Kowloon on the opposite side.

source: ساندربان ها بزرگترین کمربند درختان ساحلی حرا در جهان می باشد که به طول 80 کیلومتر (50 مایل) به مناطق داخلی بنگلادیش و هند امتداد یافته است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world, extending 80 kilometers (50 miles) into the interior of Bangladesh and India.

source: ساندربان ها به حیث ساحه میراث جهانی یونسکو اعلام شده است. قسمتی از جنگل در قلمرو هند، پارک ملی ساندربانس نامیده می شود.
english_gold: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans have been declared as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Part of the forest is located in the territory of India, and is called the Sundarbans National Park.

source: با این حال جنگل ها تنها باتلاقهای حرا نیستند - آنها شامل برخی از آخرین بقایای جنگل های بزرگ هستند که زمانی دشت گنگتیک را پوشانیده بودند.
english_gold: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
english_hypothesis: However, the forests are not only the Ganges swamps - they include some of the last remaining remnants of the large forests that once covered the Ganges plain.

source: ساندربان ها مساحتی در حدود 3850 کیلومتر مربع را پوشانیده اند که تقریباً یک سوم حصه آن را مناطق آبی/باتلاقی پوشانیده است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
english_hypothesis: Sandbanks cover an area of about 3850 square kilometers, of which about a third is covered by water/peat areas.

source: از سال 1966، ساندربان ها پناهگاه حیات وحش بوده اند و تخمین زده می شود که در حال حاضر 400 ببر رویال بنگال و حدود 30،000 گوزن خالدار در منطقه موجود می باشد.
english_gold: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
english_hypothesis: Since 1966, the Sunderbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are currently 400 Bengal tigers and about 30,000 chital deer in the area.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان قدیمی و با زبان لاتینی که در اروپا صحبت می شود قابل مقایسه است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is a ancient language and comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

source: در مورد چگونگی پیدایش سانسکریت تیوری های زیادی وجود دارد. یکی از آنها درمورد مهاجرت آریایی به هند از غرب است که زبان خود را با خود آورده بودند.
english_gold: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
english_hypothesis: There are many theories about the origin of Sanskrit. One of them is about the Aryan migration to India from the west, which brought their language with them.

source: اولین کتاب شناخته شده در جهان به زبان سانسکریت نوشته شده است. پس از تکمیل اوپانیشادها، سانسکریت بنابر تغییر سلسله ها از بین رفت.
english_gold: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
english_hypothesis: The first known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the completion of the Upanishads, Sanskrit disappeared due to the changes in dynasties.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان خیلی پیچیده و کاملی است که بعنوان منبع خادم خیلی زبان های جدید هندی بوده است، دقیقاٌ همانند زبان لاتین که منبع زبان های اروپایی مانند فرانسوی و اسپانیایی است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is a very complex and complete language that has served as a source for many modern Indian languages, exactly like the Latin language which is the source of European languages such as French and Spanish.

source: در قرن 15-پانزدهم، استونیای شمالی تحت تاثیر فرهنگی شدیدی آلمانی قرار داشت.
english_gold: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
english_hypothesis: In the 15th century, northern Estonia was under strong German cultural influence.

source: بعضی از صومعه نشینان آلمانی میخواستند خدا را به مردم بومی نزدیک بسازند، بناً زبان ساده ای استونیایی را ابداع کردند.
english_gold: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
english_hypothesis: Some of the German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they created a simple Estonian language.

source: طبق الفبای آلمانی بود و یک کرکتر "Õ/õ" اضافه شد.
english_gold: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
english_hypothesis: It was according to the German alphabet and an extra character "Õ/õ" was added.

source: با گذشت زمان، بسیاری از کلمات که از زبان آلمانی قرض گرفته شده بود با هم مدغم شدند. این شروع روشنگری بود.
english_gold: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
english_hypothesis: As time passed, many words that had been borrowed from the German language merged together. This was the beginning of the enlightenment.

source: سیکیزم دینی از شبه قاره هند است. در طول قرن 15هم در منطقه پنجاب از یک انشعاب فرقه ای از مراسم هندو سرچشمه گرفت.
english_gold: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
english_hypothesis: A religious sect from the Indian subcontinent. In the 15th century, a branch of Hindu rituals originated in the Punjab region.

source: سیک ها ایمان خود را دینی جدا از هندویسم می دانند، اگرچه ریشه ها و رسم و رواج های هندوی آن را تصدیق می کنند.
english_gold: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs consider their religion separate from Hinduism, although their roots and customs confirm Hindu influences.

source: سیک ها دین خود را گورمات می نامند که در پنجابی به معنای "راه گورو" است. گورو جنبه اساسی همه ادیان هندی است، اما در آیین سیک اهمیتی پیدا کرده است که هسته اعتقادات سیک را تشکیل می دهد.
english_gold: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs call their religion "Gurmat," which in Punjabi means "the path of the Guru." The Guru is an essential aspect of all Indian religions, but in Sikhism it has acquired a significance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

source: این دین در قرن 15هم توسط گورو ناناک (1539-1469) پایه گذاری شد. به دنبال آن (نه) گورو ای دیگر وجود داشت.
english_gold: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
english_hypothesis: This religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469-1539). After him, there were nine other Gurus.

source: محیط نظامی امپراتوری روم به توسعه پیشرفت های پزشکی کمک کرد.
english_gold: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
english_hypothesis: The military environment of the Roman Empire helped the development of medical advances.

source: داکتران توسط امپراتور اگستوس استخدام شدند و حتی اولین سپاه طبی رومی را برای استفاده در عواقب نبردها تشکیل دادند.
english_gold: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
english_hypothesis: Doctors were employed by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman medical corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

source: جراحان از داروهای آرام بخش مختلف از جمله مورفین از عصاره دانه های خشخاش و اسکوپولامین از دانه های هربان آگاهی داشتند.
english_gold: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
english_hypothesis: Surgeons were aware of different sedatives, including morphine from poppy seeds and scopolamine from herb seeds.

source: آنها در قطع عضو برای نجات مریضان از قانقاریا و همچنین استفاده از تورنیکت و گیره شریانی برای جلوگیری از جریان خود مهارت پیدا کردند.
english_gold: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
english_hypothesis: They gained skill in limb amputation to save patients from gangrene and also in using tourniquets and arterial clamps to prevent the flow.

source: در طی چندین قرن،امپراتوری روم به دستاوردهای عظیمی در زمینه طبابت منجر شد و بسیاری از دانشی را که امروز می شناسیم، تشکیل داد.
english_gold: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
english_hypothesis: Over the course of many centuries, the Roman Empire achieved great advances in medicine and formed much of the knowledge that we recognize today.

source: برای مدتی طولانی در طول قرن نوزدهم و بیستم، باور بر این بود که اولین ساکنان نیوزلند مردم مائوری بودند که پرندگان عظیم الجثه بنام مواس را شکار می نمودند.
english_gold: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
english_hypothesis: For a long time during the 19th and 20th centuries, it was believed that the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori who hunted the large birds called moas.

source: سپس این تئوری این نظریه را شکل داد که مردم مائوری با تعداد زیادی کشتی از پولینیشیا مهاجرت کردند و نیوزلند را از موریوری گرفتند و جامعه ای زراعت کار را بنیاد نهادند.
english_gold: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
english_hypothesis: Then this theory shaped the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in large numbers of canoes and took New Zealand from the Moriori and established an agricultural society.

source: با این حال، شواهد جدید حاکی از آن است که موریوری گروهی از سرزمین اصلی مائوری بودند که از نیوزلند به جزایر چاتهام مهاجرت کرده و فرهنگ متمایز و مسالمت آمیز خود را توسعه دادند.
english_gold: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
english_hypothesis: Nevertheless, new evidence indicates that the Moriori were a group from the original Maori land who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands and developed their distinct and peaceful culture.

source: قبیله دیگری نیز در جزایر چاتهام وجود داشت، اینها مائوری ها بودند که از نیوزلند مهاجرت کرده بودند.
english_gold: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
english_hypothesis: Another tribe also existed in the Chatham Islands, these were the Maoris who had migrated from New Zealand.

source: آنها خود را موریوری نامیدند، چندین کشمکش بین آنها رخ داد و در نهایت، موریوری از بین رفت.
english_gold: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
english_hypothesis: They called themselves the Mouri, several conflicts occurred between them, and finally, the Mouri disappeared.

source: مدنیت یک فرهنگ جداگانه است که بین گروه بزرگی از مردم که در یک جامعه زندگی و کار میکنند مشترک است.
english_gold: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
english_hypothesis: Civilization is a distinct culture that is shared among a large group of people who live and work in a society.

source: کلمه civilization از civil لاتین که در لاتین civis به معنی شهروند و civitas به معنای شهر یا شهر-دولت می آید و این نیز گرچه اندازه جامعه را مشخص می کند.
english_gold: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
english_hypothesis: The word civilization comes from the Latin word civil, which in Latin means citizen and civitas means city or city-state, and this also although indicates the size of the society.

source: دولت شهرها اجداد ملت ها هستند. یک فرهنگ مدنی مستلزم انتقال دانش از چندین نسل است، نشانه های فرهنگی جاودان و پخش عادلانه.
english_gold: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
english_hypothesis: The governments of cities are the ancestors of nations. A civil culture requires the transmission of knowledge from several generations, eternal cultural signs and equitable distribution.

source: فرهنگ های کوچک اغلب بدون به جا گذاشتن آثار تاریخی مرتبط ناپدید می شوند و به عنوان تمدن های خاص شناخته نمی شوند.
english_gold: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
english_hypothesis: Small cultures often disappear without leaving behind related historical artifacts and are not recognized as distinct civilizations.

source: خطوط واگن در اوایل قرن شانزدهم در انگلستان ساخته شدند.
english_gold: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
english_hypothesis: The wagon wheels were made in England in the early 16th century.

source: گرچه خطوط واگن فقط از تخته چوب های موازی تشکیل شده بودند، اما به اسب هایی که آن ها را می کشیدند امکان می داد به سرعت بیشتری رسیده و بارهای بیشتری را نسبت به جاده های ناهموار آن زمان بکشند.
english_gold: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
english_hypothesis: Although the wagon wheels were made only of parallel wooden planks, they allowed the horses that pulled them to go faster and carry more loads than the uneven roads of that time.

source: این به عملی معمول تبدیل شد، اما آهن سبب ساییدگی بیشتر چرخ های چوبی واگن گردید.
english_gold: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
english_hypothesis: It became a common practice, but iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

source: سرانجام چرخ های چوبی با چرخ های آهنی جایگزین شدند. در سال 1767، اولین خطوط ریل کاملاً فولادی معرفی شدند.
english_gold: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
english_hypothesis: Finally, wooden wheels were replaced with iron wheels. In 1767, the first fully steel rail lines were introduced.

source: گوارانی ها مهمترین گروه بومی ساکن پاراگوئه شرقی امروزی بودند و به عنوان شکارچیان نیمه کوچی زندگی می کردند که برای معیشت زراعت نیز انجام می دادند.
english_gold: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
english_hypothesis: The Guaraní were the most important native group living in eastern Paraguay today and lived as semi-nomadic hunters who also engaged in agriculture for subsistence.

source: منطقه چاکو محل اقامت گروه های دیگری از قبایل بومی مانند گایاکوری و پایاگوآ بود که با شکار، جمع کردن و ماهیگیری دوام آوردند.
english_gold: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
english_hypothesis: The Chaco region was the home of other groups of native tribes such as the Guayakuri and Payaguas, who sustained themselves through hunting, gathering, and fishing.

source: در قرن 16، پاراگوئه که قبلاً "ولایت عظیم بومیان" نامیده می شد، در نتیجه تقابل فاتحان اسپانیایی با گروه های بومی به وجود آمد.
english_gold: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
english_hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, which was previously called "The Great Native Province," emerged as a result of the conflict between Spanish conquerors and native groups.

source: اسپانیایی ها دوره استعماری را آغاز کردند که سه قرن به طول انجامید.
english_gold: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
english_hypothesis: The Spanish began a colonial period that lasted three centuries.

source: هرگونه اردو زدن پایینتر از لبه گردند کانیون نیازمند به کسب مجوز می باشد.
english_gold: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
english_hypothesis: Any camping below the canyon edge requires a permit.

source: مجوزها برای محافظت از دره محدود است و در اولین روز ماه، چهار ماه قبل از ماه اول، در دسترس قرار می گیرد.
english_gold: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
english_hypothesis: Permits for protecting the valley are limited and available one month before the first month.

source: بنابراین، مجوز رفتن به این مناطق برای هر یک از تاریخهای ماه می، از یکم ماه جنوری آغاز صادر می گردد.
english_gold: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
english_hypothesis: Therefore, the permit to go to these areas for each date in May starts issuing from the first of January.

source: فضای محبوب ترین مناطق، مانند اردوگاه Bright Angel در مجاورت Phantom Ranch، به طور کلی با درخواست های دریافت شده در اولین تاریخ که برای رزرو باز می شود، پر می گردد.
english_gold: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
english_hypothesis: The most popular areas, such as Bright Angel Campground near Phantom Ranch, generally fill up quickly with requests received on the first date that reservations open.

source: این شهر دقیقاً در کنار آبشارها قرار دارد و آنها جاذبه اصلی آن هستند، اما این مقصد گردشگری محبوب برای اقامت طولانی مدت فرصت های زیادی را برای ماجراجویان و منظره گردان ارائه می دهد.
english_gold: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
english_hypothesis: This city is exactly located next to the waterfalls and they are its main attractions, but this popular tourist destination offers many opportunities for adventurers and sightseers.

source: در فصل بارانی (نوامبر تا مارچ)، حجم آب بالاتر و آبشار مهیج تر خواهد بود.
english_gold: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
english_hypothesis: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the waterfalls will be more exciting.

source: اگر از روی پل عبور کنید یا در امتداد مسیرهایی که در نزدیکی آبشارها پیچیده اند قدم بزنید، خیس می شوید.
english_gold: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
english_hypothesis: If you cross the bridge or walk along the paths that wind near the waterfalls, you will get wet.

source: از طرف دیگر، دقیقاً به این دلیل است که حجم آب آنقدر زیاد است که مشاهده شما از آبشارهای واقعی - با وجود آن همه آب - مبهم می شود!
english_gold: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
english_hypothesis: On the other hand, it is precisely for this reason that the volume of water is so great that your perception of real waterfalls - despite all that water - becomes blurred!

source: این کوه شیب دار در منتهی الیه شمالی ماچوپیچو قد کشیده است، که اغلب پس زمینه بسیاری عکس ها از ویرانه ها می باشد.
english_gold: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
english_hypothesis: This steep mountain rises at the northern end of Machu Picchu, which is often the background of many pictures of the ruins.

source: از پایین کمی دلهره آور به نظر می رسد و صعودی شیب دار و دشوار است، اما بیشتر افراد دارای تناسب اندام نسبی می توانند در حدود 45 دقیقه این مسیر را طی کنند.

source: زینه های سنگی در امتداد قسمت بیشتر مسیر قرار داده شده است و در قسمت های شیبدارتر کیبل های فولادی دستگیره ای حمایوی فراهم می کنند.

source: پیاده روی فعالیتی در فضای باز است که شامل پیاده روی در محیط های طبیعی، اغلب در مسیرهای پیاده روی می شود.

english_hypothesis: Hiking is an outdoor activity that involves walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

source: گرچه بسیاری از حیوانات موجود در پارک به دیدن انسان عادت دارند، با این وجود حیوانات وحشی هستند و نباید به آنها غذا داده شود یا مزاحمتی برای آنها ایجاد گردد.

source: این توصیه فرض می کند که مسافران سرقت نمی کنند، تخطی نمی کنند، در بازار غیرقانونی شرکت نمی کنند، گدایی نمی کنند و یا از دیگران در جهت منافع خود سوء استفاده نمی کنند.

source: در حالی که به حیث بازدید کننده یا به هدف تجارت شما برای سفرهای کوتاه به کشورهای مختلف نیاز به ویزه نداشته باشید، مسافرت به آنجا به حیث محصل معمولاً به نسبت توریستی عادی نیاز به اقامت طولانی تر دارد.

english_hypothesis: Usually, long-term stay in any foreign country requires you to obtain a visa in advance.

source: در کل شرایط و طرزالعمل هایی درخواست ویزه تحصیلی با ویزه سیاحتی یا تجاری متفاوت است.

english_hypothesis: In general, the conditions and procedures for a student visa are different from a tourist or business visa.

source: برای اکثر کشورها، شما نامه معرفی نهادی که می خواهید در آن تحصیل نمایید، و همچنان حداقل شواهد استطاعت مالی مورد نیاز سال اول دوره تحصیلی خود را ضرورت خواهید داشت.

source: اروپا قاره ای نسبتاً کوچک اما دارای کشورهایی مستقل زیاد است. در شرایط عادی، سفر از طریق چندین کشور به معنی چندین بار طی مراحل درخواست های ویزه و کنترول پاسپورت می باشد.

english_hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent but has many independent countries. In normal conditions, traveling through several countries means going through several times the procedures for visa applications and passport control.

english_gold: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
english_hypothesis: But the Schengen area functions somewhat like a single country in this regard.

source: مسافرینی که به آسانی با فرهنگ جدید سازگاری پیدا می کنند، در برخی از موارد در سازگاری مجدد با فرهنگ محلی خود با مشکلاتی مواجه می شوند.

source: پروتون ها داری بار الکتریکی مثبت هستند در حالی که نیوترون ها بدون بار هستند. الکترون ها بار الکتریکی منفی دارند.
english_gold: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
english_hypothesis: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons are uncharged. Electrons have a negative electric charge.

source: حجره کوچکترین واحد ساختمانی و وظیفوی یک جاندار (چیز) است.
english_gold: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
english_hypothesis: The cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism (thing).

source: حجره از واژه لاتین cella به معنی اتاق کوچک گرفته شده است.
english_gold: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
english_hypothesis: The word "cella" is derived from the Latin word "cella" meaning a small room.

source: اگر یک موجود زنده را در زیر میکروسکوپ نگاه بیاندازید، مشاهده خواهید کرد که آنها از مربع ها یا دایره های کوچک ساخته شده اند.
english_gold: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
english_hypothesis: If you look at a living organism under a microscope, you will see that they are made up of small squares or circles.

source: آنها شبیه اطاق بودند. او اولین شخصی بود که حجرات مرده را مشاهده کرد.
english_gold: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
english_hypothesis: They were like a room. He was the first person to see the dead bodies.

source: زمان چیزی است که در اطراف ما می باشد و بر همه کارهایی که انجام میدهیم تاثیر می گذارد، اما هنوز هم درک آن دشوار است.
english_gold: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
english_hypothesis: Time is something that is around us and affects all the things we do, but it is still difficult to understand.

source: ما زمان را بشکل مجموعه ای از رخدادهای آینده که از زمان حال به گذشته می گذرند، تجربه می کنیم.
english_gold: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
english_hypothesis: We experience time as a set of future events that pass from the present to the past.

source: همچنین، زمان، چگونگی مقایسه مدت (طول) رخدادها می باشد.
english_gold: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
english_hypothesis: Also, time is the way of comparing the duration (length) of events.

source: شما می توانید گذر زمان را با مشاهده تکرار یک رویداد دورانی مشخص کنید. یک رویداد دورانی چیزی است که بارها و بارها به طور منظم اتفاق می افتد.
english_gold: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
english_hypothesis: You can determine the passage of time by observing the repetition of a specific periodic event. A periodic event is something that happens repeatedly in a regular manner.

source: در حال حاضر MySpace در ایالت متحده سومین ویب سایت مشهور است و 54 میلیون استفاده کننده دارد.
english_gold: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
english_hypothesis: MySpace is currently the third most popular website in the United States and has 54 million users.

source: این وبسایت ها توجه زیاد بخود جلب کرده است، مخصوصاً در عرصه تحصیلات.
english_gold: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
english_hypothesis: These websites have attracted a lot of attention, especially in the field of education.

source: این ویب سایت ها دارای جنبه های مثبت می باشند مانند: آسانی در تنظیم یک صفحه صنفی که شامل بلاگ ها، ویدیوها، عکس ها، و دیگر خصوصیات میگردد.
english_gold: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
english_hypothesis: These websites have positive aspects such as: ease of setting up a classified page that includes blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

source: این صفحه به اسانی با فراهم سازی فقط یک آدرس انترنتی در دسترس است، که هم برای بحافظه سپردن و هم تایپ کردن برای شاگردان که در قسمت استفاده کیبورد یا املا مشکل دارند آسان ساخته شده است.
english_gold: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
english_hypothesis: This page is easily accessible by providing just one Internet address, which has been made easy for both memorization and typing for students who have problems with the keyboard or spelling.

source: میشود آنرا بطور فرمایشی ساخت که خواندنش آسان و با هر قدر کم یا بیش رنگ مطابق میل باشد.
english_gold: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
english_hypothesis: It can be made in a style that is easy to read and matches the taste, whether with little or more color.

source: اپلیکیشن های ترجمه متن لحظه ای - اپلیکیشن هایی که قابلیت ترجمه خودکار بخش هایی از متن یک زبان به زبان دیگر را دارند.
english_gold: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
english_hypothesis: Instant text translation applications - applications that have the ability to automatically translate parts of text from one language to another.

source: برخی از اپلیکیشن هایی که شامل این کتگوری می شوند حتی می توانند نوشته های زبان های خارجی که روی علائم یا اشیاء دیگر در دنیای واقعی نوشته شده اند، در زمانی که کاربر تلفون هوشمند را به سمت آن اشیاء نشان می گیرد ترجمه کنند.
english_gold: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
english_hypothesis: Some applications that include this category can even translate texts in foreign languages that are written on signs or other objects in the real world, when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

source: ماشین های ترجمه به طور چشمگیری بهبود یافته اند، و در حال حاضر اغلب ترجمه هایی نسبتاً صحیح (و به ندرت بی مفهوم) انجام می دهند، اما نیاز به توجه دارند، زیرا ممکن تمام متن را اشتباه ترجمه کرده باشند.
english_gold: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
english_hypothesis: Machine translations have improved significantly, and currently often perform relatively accurate (and rarely nonsensical) translations, but they still require attention, because they might have mistranslated the entire text.

source: یکی از عالی ترین اپلیکیشن ها در این کتگوری گوگل ترانسلیت است که پس از دانلود داده زبان مورد نظر امکان ترجمه آفلاین را فراهم می کند.
english_gold: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
english_hypothesis: One of the top applications in this category is Google Translate, which provides the ability to translate offline after downloading the desired language data.

source: زبان های رسمی بارسلونا کاتالان و اسپانیایی می باشد. تقریباً نصف شهر به زبان کاتالان صحبت می کند، اکثریت مطلق این زبان را می فهمند، و در واقع تمام نفوس این شهر زبان آسپانیایی را می دانند.
english_gold: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
english_hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Almost half the city speaks Catalan, the majority understand this language, and in fact all the population of this city know Spanish.

source: به هر حال، اکثر علائم فقط به زبان کاتالان نشان داده می شود، زیرا طبق قانون کاتالان به عنوان اولین زبان رسمی تعیین شده است.
english_gold: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
english_hypothesis: In any case, most signs are displayed only in Catalan, because according to the law, Catalan is established as the first official language.

source: با این وجود، اسپانیایی همچنان به شکل گسترده در ترانسپورت عمومی و سایر امکانات استفاده می شود.
english_gold: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
english_hypothesis: Nevertheless, Spanish is still widely used in public transport and other facilities.

source: آگهی های معمول در مترو فقط به زبان کاتالان نوشته می شوند، اما اختلالات پلان نشده به وسیله سیستمی خودکار به زبان های مختلف از جمله اسپانیایی، انگلیسی، فرانسوی، عربی و جاپانی اعلام می شود.
english_gold: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
english_hypothesis: Regular announcements in the metro are written only in Catalan, but unexpected disruptions are announced in different languages by an automated system, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی از قرن نوزدهم وجود داشته اند. آژانس مسافرتی معمولاً گزینه مناسبی برای سفری است که فراتر از تجربه قبلی مسافر از طبیعت، فرهنگ، زبان یا کشورهای کم درآمد می باشد.
english_gold: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies have existed since the 19th century. A travel agency is usually a suitable option for a trip that goes beyond the traveler's previous experience of nature, culture, language, or low-income countries.

source: اگرچند اغلب آژانس ها مایل به رزروهای معمولی هستند، اما بسیاری از نمایندگان در نوع خاصی از سفرها، محدوده بودجه یا مقاصد تخصص دارند.
english_gold: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
english_hypothesis: Although agencies are often willing to make regular reservations, many agents specialize in specific types of travel, budget ranges, or destinations.

source: بهتر است از آژانسی استفاده کنید که اغلب سفرهای مشابه مورد شما را رزرو می کند.
english_gold: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
english_hypothesis: It is better to use an agency that often books similar trips to yours.

source: به سفرهای تبلیغی آژانس، در ویب سایت و در ویترین دکان نگاهی بیندازید.
english_gold: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
english_hypothesis: Check the agency's promotional trips, on the website, and in the shop window.

source: رزرو پیش از وقت به مسافر آرامش ذهنی می دهد که پس از رسیدن به مقصد، جایی برای خواب خواهد داشت.
english_gold: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
english_hypothesis: Booking in advance gives travelers peace of mind that after arriving at their destination, they will have a place to stay.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی اغلب با هوتل های خاصی تعامل می کنند، اگرچه ممکن است از طریق آژانسی مسافرتی امکان رزرو سایر اقامتگاه ها مانند محل کمپینگ را پیدا کنید.
english_gold: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies often work with specific hotels, although you may be able to find the option to book other accommodations such as camping sites through a travel agency.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی معمولاً بسته هایی را ارائه میدهند که شامل صبحانه، ترتیبات ترانسپورت به/از میدان هوایی یا حتی پروازهای ترکیبی و بسته های هوتل می گردد.
english_gold: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies usually offer packages that include breakfast, transport arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flights and hotel packages.

source: در صورت نیاز به زمان برای فکر کردن در مورد پیشنهاد یا تهیه اسناد دیگر برای مقصد (به عنوان مثال روادید)، آنها می توانند برای شما رزرویشن را نگاه کنند.
english_gold: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
english_hypothesis: In case you need time to think about the offer or prepare other documents for the purpose (e.g. visa), they can look after your reservation.

source: هرگونه اصلاحات یا درخواست باید در ابتدا از طریق آژانس مسافرتی و نه مستقیماً با هوتل انجام شود.
english_gold: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
english_hypothesis: Any changes or requests must be made initially through the travel agency and not directly with the hotel.

source: قوانین معمول عکاسی برای فیلمبرداری یا حتی ممکن موارد دیگر نیز تطبیق می گردد.
english_gold: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
english_hypothesis: The usual rules of photography also apply to filming or even other cases.

source: در صورتی که عکس گرفتن از چیزی مجاز نیست، شما نباید حتی فکر فیلمبرداری از آن را داشته باشید.
english_gold: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
english_hypothesis: If taking a picture of something is not allowed, you should not even think about filming it.

source: اگر از پهباد و یا طیارهء بدون سرنشین استفاده می کنید، پیش از وقت خوب بررسی کنید از چه چیزهای می توانید فیلم بگیرید و چه جوازها یا تصدیق های اضافی ضرورت می باشد.
english_gold: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
english_hypothesis: If you use a drone or an unmanned aircraft, check well before time what you can film and what additional permits or certifications are required.

source: استفاده از درون نزدیک به میدان هوایی یا بالای جمعیت، حتی اگر این کار در ساحه شما غیرقانونی نباشد، تقریباً همیشه یک ایده نامناسب است.
english_gold: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
english_hypothesis: Using the proximity to an airport or a crowd, even if it is not illegal in your area, is almost always a bad idea.

source: برخلاف دیگر اولیه ها ، انسان ها دیگر از دستان خود برای حرکت یا تحمل وزن یا چرخش در میان درختان استفاده نمی کنند.
english_gold: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
english_hypothesis: Unlike other primates, humans no longer use their hands for movement or bearing weight or swinging among trees.

source: دست و پای شامپانزه از نظر اندازه و طول مشابه است که نشان دهنده استفاده دست برای تحمل وزن در راه رفتن با بند انگشت است.
english_gold: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
english_hypothesis: The hands and feet of chimpanzees are similar in size and length, indicating the use of hands for weight bearing during walking on fingers.

source: دست انسان کوتاهتر از پا است و استخوان های صاف تری دارد.
english_gold: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
english_hypothesis: Human hand is shorter than the foot and has flatter bones.

source: استخوان های فسیلی دست دو میلیون تا سه میلیون ساله نشان دهنده این تغییر در تخصص دست از حرکت به دستکاری است.
english_gold: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
english_hypothesis: Fossilized bones of two million to three million years old indicate this change in hand specialization from movement to manipulation.

source: MRI براساس پدیده ای فیزیکی به نام رزونانس مغناطیسی هسته ای (NMR) می باشد که در دهه 1930 توسط فلیکس بلوخ (استاد دانشگاه استنفورد) و ادوارد پورسل (از دانشگاه هاروارد) کشف شد.
english_gold: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
english_hypothesis: MRI is based on a physical phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (professor at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

source: در این رزونانس، میدان مغناطیسی و امواج رادیویی باعث می شوند اتم ها سیگنال های رادیویی کوچکی را منتشر کنند.
english_gold: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
english_hypothesis: In this resonance, the magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to emit small radio signals.

source: در سال 1970، ریموند دامادیان ، داکتر طب معالجوی و دانشمندی محقق، مبنای استفاده از تصویربرداری توسط رزونانس مغناطیسی را به حیث وسیله ای برای معاینات طبی کشف کرد.
english_gold: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
english_hypothesis: In 1970, Raymond Damadian, a physician, researcher and scientist, discovered the basis for using imaging through magnetic resonance as a tool for medical examinations.

source: چهار سال بعد حق ثبت اختراع آن صادر شد، که اولین اختراع ثبت‌ شده جهان در زمینه MRI بود.
english_gold: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
english_hypothesis: Four years later, the patent was issued, which was the first registered invention in the world in the field of MRI.

source: داکتر دامادیان ساخت اولین اسکنر MRI "کل بدن" را که "تسخیر ناپذیر" نامید را در سال 1977 به پایان رساند.
english_gold: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
english_hypothesis: Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first "whole body" MRI scanner, which he called "Inexorable," in 1977.

source: برای کسانی که با اصطلاحات طبی آشنا نیستند، واژه های عفونی و واگیر دارای معانی متمایزی هستند.
english_gold: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
english_hypothesis: For those who are not familiar with the terminology of medicine, the words "infectious" and "contagious" have different meanings.

source: یک مریضی عفونی به وسیله عاملی بیماریزا مانند ویروس، باکتری، قارچ یا سایر انگل ها ایجاد می شود.
english_gold: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
english_hypothesis: An infectious disease is caused by a pathogenic agent such as a virus, bacterium, fungus, or other parasites.

source: مرض ساری مرضی است که با قرار گرفتن در مجاورت فرد آلوده به راحتی منتقل می شود.
english_gold: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
english_hypothesis: Sari is a disease that can be easily transmitted by being in contact with an infected person.

source: آنفلونزای مرغی یا به شکل رسمی آنفلونزای پرندگان، می تواند هم پرندگان و هم پستانداران را آلوده کند.
english_gold: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
english_hypothesis: Avian influenza or in its formal name bird flu, can infect both birds and mammals.

source: تاکنون کمتر از هزار مورد در انسان گزارش شده است، اما برخی از آن موارد مهلک بوده است.
english_gold: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
english_hypothesis: Less than a thousand cases have been reported in humans so far, but some of them have been fatal.

source: بیشتر شامل کسانی که در فارم های پرورش مرغ مصروف بوده می شدند، اما برای نگهدارندگان پرندگان نیز تا حدی ریسک وجود دارد.
english_gold: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
english_hypothesis: Most were people who worked in poultry farms, but there was also some risk for bird keepers.

source: استفاده از فلمبرداری منجر به اکتشافات مهمی در تفسیر عبارات کوچک، حرکات صورت که چند میلی ثانیه طول دارد، شده است.
english_gold: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
english_hypothesis: The use of filmography has led to important discoveries in interpreting small expressions, facial movements that last a few milliseconds.

source: به طور خاص، ادعا می شود که می توان با تفسیر صحیح عبارات خورد، تشخیص داد که آیا یک شخص دروغ می گوید یا خیر.
