english_gold: When asked what the father said, she answered "He couldn't say a thing - he just stood there blinking."
english_hypothesis: When asked what the father had said, he said, "He could not say anything - he just stood there blinking."

source: مسافرانی که در حال برنامه ریزی برای تغییر جنسیت در خارج از کشور هستند، باید اطمینان حاصل کنند مدارکی معتبر برای سفر برگشت دارند.
english_gold: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
english_hypothesis: Travelers who are planning to change their gender outside the country should ensure they have valid documents for return travel.

source: تمایل دولت ها برای صدور پاسپورت با جنسیت نامعین (X) یا اسناد به روز شده برای مطابقت با نام دلخواه و جنسیت متفاوت است.
english_gold: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
english_hypothesis: Governments' tendency to issue passports with non-binary (X) gender or updated documents to match the preferred name and different gender.

source: تمایل دولت های خارجی برای احترام به این اسناد نیز به همان اندازه متغیر است.
english_gold: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
english_hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to respect these documents is also equally variable.

source: افراد تراجنسیتی پیش از عملیات نباید انتظار داشته باشند که عبور از اسکنرها با حفظ حریم خصوصی و حفظ شأن آنها صورت پذیرد.
english_gold: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
english_hypothesis: Transgender people should not have to wait to pass through the scanners while maintaining their privacy and dignity.

source: غذای هنگی در گودالی داغ داخل زمین پخته می شود.
english_gold: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
english_hypothesis: The hungarian food is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

source: این گودال یا با سنگ های داغ ناشی از آتش گرم می شود، یا در برخی نقاط حرارت زمین گرمایی باعث می شود مناطق زمین به طور طبیعی داغ شوند.
english_gold: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
english_hypothesis: This gully is either heated by hot stones from the fire, or in some places, geothermal heat causes the ground areas to become hot naturally.

source: هنگی اغلب برای پخت شامی سنتی به سبک کباب استفاده می شود.
english_gold: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
english_hypothesis: Lamb is often used for traditional Afghan-style kebab.

source: چندین مکان در روتوروا هنگی زمین گرمایی را ارائه می دهند، در حالی که سایر هنگی ها را می توان در کرایست چرچ، ولینگتون و جاهای دیگر خورد.
english_gold: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
english_hypothesis: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal areas, while other hot springs can be found in Christchurch, Wellington and other places.

source: Cinque Terre که به معنی پنج سرزمین است، از پنج روستای ساحلی کوچک ریماگیور، مانارولا، کورنگلیا، ویرنازا و مونتیروسو واقع در قسمت لاتین لیگوریا شکل یافته است.
english_gold: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
english_hypothesis: Cinque Terre, meaning five lands, is formed by five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, and Monterosso located in the Latin part of Liguria.

source: آنها در لست میراث های جهانی یونسکو قرار گرفته اند.
english_gold: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
english_hypothesis: They are listed as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

source: طی قرن ها، مردم بالکن هایی بهاری را با دقت بر روی چشم انداز ناهموار و شیب دار صخره هایی که مشرف به دریا هستند ساخته اند.
english_gold: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
english_hypothesis: For centuries, people have carefully built Balkan-style summer homes on the rugged, sloping cliffs overlooking the sea.

source: عدم انکشاف متحد قابل مشاهده جزیی از جذابیت آن است. مسیرها، قطارها و قایق ها قریه جات را به هم متصل نموده و موترها از بیرون نمی توانند به آنجا برسند.
english_gold: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
english_hypothesis: The lack of visible development is part of its charm. The paths, trains, and boats connect the villages, and the cars cannot reach there from outside.

source: محمد عمیقاً به مسایلی فراتر از این زندگی روزمره علاقه مند بود. او برای اندیشیدن در غاری که بنام <حرا> در کوه "نور" (شرونی) معروف شد رفت و آمد می کرد.
english_gold: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
english_hypothesis: Mohammad was deeply interested in issues beyond this everyday life. He used to go and come to a cave known as "Hira" in the mountain "Nur" (Shroni).

source: خود غار که از زمان ها سالم مانده است، نمای خیلی واضحی از گرایشات معنوی محمد به دست می دهد.
english_gold: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
english_hypothesis: The cave itself, which has remained intact for ages, provides a very clear indication of Muhammad's spiritual inclinations.

source: این غار که در قسمت بالای یکی از کوه های شمال مکه قرار دارد، کاملاً از دیگر نقاط جهان مجزا بنظر میرسد.
english_gold: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
english_hypothesis: This cave, located in the upper part of one of the mountains north of Mecca, seems completely isolated from other parts of the world.

source: چیزی جز آسمان صاف و زیبای بالا و کوه های متعدد اطراف آن دیده نمی شود. خیلی کم از این دنیا را می توان از داخل غار دید یا شنید.
english_gold: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
english_hypothesis: Nothing is seen except the clear and beautiful sky above and the numerous mountains around it. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.

source: از آنجا که مونته ویدئو در جنوب خط استوا قرار دارد، زمانی که در نیمکره شمالی زمستان است در آنجا تابستان می باشد و برعکس.
english_gold: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
english_hypothesis: Because Montevideo is located in the southern hemisphere, when it is winter in the northern hemisphere, it is summer there and vice versa.

source: مونته ویدئو در منطقه نیمه گرمسیری قرار دارد. معمولاً در ماه های تابستان دما 30+ درجه سانتی گراد است.
english_gold: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
english_hypothesis: Monte Video is located in the temperate zone. Usually, the temperature in the summer months is 30+ degrees Celsius.

source: زمستان می تواند به طرز فریبنده ای سرد باشد: درجه حرارت به ندرت به زیر صفر می رسد، اما ترکیب باد و رطوبت باعث می شود سرما نسبت به درجه نمایش داده شده روی دماسنج سردتر احساس گردد.
english_gold: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
english_hypothesis: Winter can be surprisingly cold: temperatures rarely go below zero, but the combination of wind and humidity makes the cold feel colder than the temperature shown on the thermometer.

source: هیچ فصل بارانی و خشک خاصی وجود ندارد: میزان بارندگی در طول سال تقریباً یکسان است.
english_gold: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
english_hypothesis: There is no specific rainy and dry season: the amount of rainfall throughout the year is almost the same.

source: ورزش های برفی در سراشیبی، که شامل اسکی و اسنوبورد است، ورزش های پرطرفداری هستند که شامل سر خوردن روی زمین های پوشیده از برف با اسکی یا اسنوبورد چسبیده به پاهایتان است.
english_gold: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
english_hypothesis: Snow sports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports that involve sliding on snow-covered ground with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.

source: اسکی یک فعالیت اصلی مسافرتی با تعداد زیادی علاقمند است، گاهی اوقات به عنوان "بوم اسکی"، پلان ریزی برای تمامی تعطیلات حول محور اسکی در یک مکان خاص شناخته میشود.
english_gold: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
english_hypothesis: Skiing is a major tourist activity with a large number of enthusiasts, sometimes called "Skiing Country," and planning for all the holidays centered around skiing in a specific location is known.

source: نظریه اسکی سواری بسیار قدیمی است - نگاره های مغاره ای که اسکی بازان را نمایش میدهد به 5000 سال قبل از میلاد باز می گردد!
english_gold: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
english_hypothesis: The theory of skiing is very old - cave paintings depicting skiers date back to 5000 years before Christ!

source: اسکی در سراشیبی به عنوان یک سپورت حداقل به قرن 17 برمی گردد و در سال 1861 اولین کلب اسکی تفریحی توسط نروژی ها در استرالیا افتتاح شد.
english_gold: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
english_hypothesis: Skiing dates back to at least the 17th century as a sport, and the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia in 1861.

source: نوشیدنی های الکلی را در حد اعتدال بنوشید. مشروبات الکلی تاثیر متفاوت روی افراد می گذارد، و دانستن حد خود بسیار مهم است.
english_gold: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
english_hypothesis: Drink alcoholic beverages in moderation. Alcohol affects people differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

source: کازینوها معمولاً تلاش بسیاری می کنند تا زمان و پول صرف شده توسط مهمانان را به حداکثر برسانند. معمولا کلکین و ساعت وجود ندارند، و یافتن خروجی ها دشوار است.
english_gold: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
english_hypothesis: Casinos usually try to maximize the time and money spent by their guests. Usually, there are no clocks or windows, and finding exits is difficult.

source: آنها معمولاً پیشنهادات غذایی، نوشیدنی و سرگرمی خاص دارند تا مهمانان را در خلق و خوی خوب نگاه داشته و در تعمیر حفظ دارند.
english_gold: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
english_hypothesis: They usually have special food, drink, and entertainment offers to keep guests in a good mood and maintain their repair.

source: برخی از مکان ها نوشیدنی های الکلی رایگان ارائه می دهند. با این حال، مستی قضاوت را مختل می کند و تمام قماربازان خوب اهمیت هوشیار بودن را می دانند.
english_gold: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
english_hypothesis: Some places offer free alcoholic drinks. However, intoxication impairs judgment and all good gamblers know the importance of being alert.
